answer.reason: The six keys are the vendor's literal JobState strings, but each one maps to a BureauStage (Offered, Assigned, Drafting, Proofing, Delivered, Queried). The ARCHITECTURE.md glossary names each of those stages and attaches a bureau rule to it, so the domain owns these distinctions even though they match the vendor's one for one. Separately, keying a lookup in the domain on vendor text is a vendor-co
